title: Thieves
opening_posts: I'm not keen on this at all. I can see it working in multiplayer when there's several of you to handle the thief whilst the others continue working, but on my own it happens when I'm obviously busy and I never have time to deal with it, meaning I am a sitting duck and just keep losing money. I have never been keen on the thief mechanic in simulators and would ask if we could have a toggle to remove them all together if we want to? Other than that, liking the game so far!
comments: Was your register open? I'm trying to figure out ways to counter that. There's a staff but only for register that I know of. Maybe that one?

Register wasn't open. It was left open after the thief had been in it though. I don't think there's a way to counter it except to "fight", but nine times out of ten I'm already engaged in something else and I just don't like the mechanic anyway. I think it detracts from the chill feel of the game. I don't know why it's so often introduced into simulators.
I agree, this should be a toggle.
I also don't think it helps that it still happens when the shop is closed or when I'm using the computer.
Hopefully a toggle for it comes soon like Super Market Simulator but lets give some grace as it literally just came out haha

Yeah, watched some of the game on youtube, looks very interesting but I think I'll just put it on wishlist until/if there is a toggle for that added (Fun in theory...but I can see that getting old REAL fast after the first few times)

title: Cart control feedback / Suggestion for cart controls
opening_posts: I started playing today, and I noticed that the control system for moving the cart is somewhat awkward and hard to manage. It would be greatly appreciated if the cart controls could be improved for better accessibility in a future update.
comments: I agree
just let us use the cart as first person, its so hard to drive the cart in third person view

I think what they were going for was realism for the card controls, it handles very much like a cart like that in real life, making it a nightmare in game and in third person. I think it should handle just like your player character and be completely smooth, because as it is, there's no point even really using it it feels like.
Lol that cart is atrocious! I have been just carrying everything in by hand! I gave up on it!
